title: Aquaman #4 DC 1986 Mini-Series Epic Conclusion Craig Hamilton P Craig Russell
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Back cover lightly toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
Aquaman #4 of 4 (May 1986), DC Comics - "The Epic Conclusion!" of the 1986 mini-series that introduced Aquaman's blue camouflage costume. Written by Neal Pozner, art by Craig Hamilton, cover by Craig Hamilton and P. Craig Russell. 75c cover price.

Back cover: Monogram Lightning radio-controlled racer ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
